name: @rayspec/fixture-pack
description: The in-tree extension pack that exercises the claimed-section seam end to end. It claims ONE top-level section (`auditing`) and ships the validator for it, and the deployment documents beside it are loaded through the REAL loader from THIS directory, with a REAL exact version pin. Unlike the @spike/* example packs it is a normal @rayspec/* workspace member, so the CI filters build and typecheck it: a fixture excluded from CI proves nothing. It builds to dist/ because the deploy runtime loads compiled JavaScript only, and a deployment document points at that directory.
